messages.en:
{07 00 00}But anyway, {04 1f 00},
{07 16 00}I really want to thank you
for lookin' out for me.
{07 08 00}I know this might seem a 
little extreme, but I owe
you big-time, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 17 00}I got a little delirious
there for a while. I hope
I didn't weird you out.
{07 14 00}I'm gonna give you a little
something to show you how
much I appreciate it!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Igatahes, {04 1f 00},
{07 16 00}ma tahan sind tänada,
et sa minu eest hoolitsesid.
{07 08 00}Ma tean, et see võib
tunduda liialdusena, aga ma
olen sulle võlgu, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 17 00}Ma läksin mõneks ajaks
sonimisse. Loodan, et ma
sind ei ehmatanud.
{07 14 00}Ma annan sulle väikese
kingituse, et näidata, kui
väga ma seda hindan!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Listen up, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 0a 00}I'm {01 00 00 05 00}feelin' great, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Thanks for watchin' my back
when I was down.

{07 17 00}I went a little delirious
there. I hope I didn't say
anything too weird.
{07 0d 00}Anyway, I'm back and
better than ever.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kuula, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 0a 00}Mul on {01 00 00 05 00}suurepärane olla,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Aitäh, et mu selga valvasid,
kui ma maas olin.

{07 17 00}Ma läksin natuke sonima.
Loodan, et ma ei öelnud
midagi liiga imelikku.
{07 0d 00}Igatahes, ma olen tagasi
ja parem kui iial varem.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}! Thanks to you,
I'm feeling way better!

{07 08 00}You really reminded me 
of how great friends are{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.

{07 00 00}I've gotta do something 
to thank you for nursin'
me back to my cranky self.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}! Tänu sinule
on mul palju parem!

{07 08 00}Sa tuletasid mulle tõesti
meelde, kui head on sõbrad{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}

{07 00 00}Ma pean midagi tegema,
et sind tänada, et mu
pahura mina tagasi tõid.
